evaluation.name: Product catalogue — vendor check
evaluation.identitySame: Both records describe the same product (the same item in the same variant), even if the name, description or formatting differs.
evaluation.identityDifferent: The records describe different products, including different variants (size, colour, capacity or edition), bundles or multipacks of the item, or similarly named products from different brands.
